Sophisticated Design, Simple Upkeep

While decorative window films provide a high-end, sophisticated look, they are surprisingly practical and easy to care for. Unlike specialty glass which can sometimes require special cleaning agents, our installed films are designed to withstand the rigors of daily life in both homes and busy commercial environments. They feature a tough, scratch-resistant coating that protects the film's design and ensures it stays looking great for years to come.

Simple Cleaning Routine

Maintaining your decorative window film is no different from cleaning a standard window. There's no special process or expensive products required.

  • Use Standard Cleaners: A simple solution of water and a few drops of mild dish soap, or any standard, ammonia-free glass cleaner, is all you need.
  • Use Soft Materials: Clean the film with a soft cloth, paper towel, or a clean synthetic sponge. A rubber squeegee is also excellent for a streak-free finish.
  • No Abrasives: Simply avoid using abrasive cleaning pads or harsh, ammonia-based chemicals, as these can damage the film's surface over time.

Durability for High-Traffic Areas

We use high-quality, commercial-grade films from top manufacturers like 3M and Solyx. These products are engineered for longevity and performance.

  • Scratch-Resistant: The protective top coat resists accidental scratches from daily use, keeping the design pristine.
  • Moisture Resistant: Our films are suitable for use in humid environments like bathrooms or on shower doors without peeling or bubbling.
  • Long-Lasting Adhesives: The advanced adhesives form a powerful, long-lasting bond with the glass, ensuring your film won't peel, crack, or lift.
  • Comprehensive Warranty: Our installations are backed by extensive manufacturer warranties, giving you peace of mind that your investment is protected.

Enjoy the perfect combination of form and function. With decorative window film, you get stunning aesthetics without adding a complicated maintenance routine to your life.

Frequently Asked Questions

How soon can I clean my windows after the film is installed?

We recommend waiting 30 days after installation before cleaning your new film. This allows the adhesive to fully cure and bond with the glass.

Will the film's pattern or color fade over time?

No. Our high-quality decorative films are manufactured with UV inhibitors and stable pigments to ensure the colors and patterns remain vibrant and true for the life of the product.

What happens if the film gets a deep scratch?

While the films are very durable, a deep or intentional scratch can damage the surface. The good news is that, unlike scratched glass, the film can be easily replaced. Our technicians can remove the damaged panel and install a new one, restoring the perfect finish.
